task_fulfillment.rationale: The deliverable supplies a reproducible adopted size of 65 and 65 selected rows, with useful variance and coverage notes. However, it treats unsupported business/entity proxies as satisfying required coverage. Disclosure does not establish equivalence. A1/C1 is appropriately left unresolved rather than guessed. Full population reconciliation, exact tab names, rendering and recalculation remain unverified; no unnecessary hold was identified.

task_defect.reason: R14 conflicts with the request: J is the variance column and K is the selection column. The request's H/I quarter positions also conflict with the reference's G/H headers. Metric-code and entity/business equivalence mappings are not established, limiting fair judgment of complete coverage and population size.
